title.zh: 台股重挫4.4%至38,426.89,为史上第七大单日点数跌幅;台积电跌3.45%
title.en: Taiwan stocks plunge 4.4% to 38,426.89, the seventh-largest one-day point drop on record; TSMC down 3.45%

analysis.zh: 据台湾中央社,加权指数周四收盘跌1,768.02点或4.4%,收在38,426.89,跌破40,000点与240日均线;成交额约8,953亿新台币,外资净卖出约243亿新台币。台积电跌3.45%至2,100新台币,联电、联发科分别跌5.16%和5.58%。报道指美国科技股疲弱引发大面积卖压,市场担心英伟达在高层变动后收紧成本控制,压缩台湾供应商的高利润。就像一栋楼里最大的住户搬家,整栋楼的商铺都会担心人流变少。
analysis.en: According to Focus Taiwan, the Taiex closed down 1,768.02 points, or 4.4%, at 38,426.89 on Thursday, falling below 40,000 and its 240-day moving average; turnover was about NT$895.3 billion and foreign investors were net sellers of about NT$24.3 billion. TSMC fell 3.45% to NT$2,100, while UMC and MediaTek lost 5.16% and 5.58%. The report said weakness in US tech shares set off broad selling, and investors worry Nvidia may tighten cost controls after its executive changes, squeezing Taiwan suppliers' high margins. It is like the largest tenant in a building moving out: every shop in the building starts to worry about foot traffic.

dda.zh: 单日大跌时情绪最容易主导决定。定期定额(DDA)按固定节奏投入,一般有助于在不同价位平均成本,也减少因恐慌而中断计划的机会。
dda.en: Big one-day drops are when emotion tends to drive decisions. Regular (DDA) investing at a fixed rhythm may help average the entry cost across price levels and reduce the chance of abandoning a plan out of panic.

prs.zh: 退休规划的时间跨度通常是十几二十年,单日波动影响有限。可以借此检视PRS基金是否过度集中在科技或单一地区,也别忘了每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免。
prs.en: Retirement planning usually spans one or two decades, so a single day's swing has limited weight. It may be a good time to check whether your PRS fund leans too heavily on tech or one region, and to remember the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 市场急跌后,单笔投资更需留意时机风险。分批投入可以分散入市时机,同时检查是否过度集中在半导体等同一主题,金额应符合个人目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: After a sharp fall, lump sum investing carries more timing risk. Phasing in may spread entry timing, and it is worth checking for concentration in one theme such as semiconductors; the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 台股大跌属于区域风险情绪事件,对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响通常有限,但资金避险时可能影响令吉与外资流向。债券基金在组合中一般起到平衡波动的作用。
bond.en: A Taiwan equity sell-off is mainly a regional risk-sentiment event, so its direct effect on Malaysian bond funds is generally limited, though risk-off flows may touch the ringgit and foreign flows. Bond funds generally serve as a balancer for portfolio volatility.

title.zh: 恒指跌453点至22,841创四个月新低,腾讯跌6.6%、阿里跌5.5%
title.en: Hang Seng plunges 453 points to 22,841, a four-month low, as Tencent falls 6.6% and Alibaba 5.5%

analysis.zh: 据The Standard,恒生指数周四跌453点(约2%)至22,841,为四个月来最低;恒生科技指数跌2.3%至3,649,成交额约2,295亿港元。腾讯公布业绩后跌6.6%,阿里巴巴在业绩公布前跌5.5%。内地方面,上证综指跌0.3%至3,577,深证成指跌0.7%至10,583。就像一支球队两名主力同时受伤,整体表现自然受到拖累。
analysis.en: According to The Standard, the Hang Seng Index fell 453 points, or about 2%, to 22,841 on Thursday, its lowest in four months; the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 2.3% to 3,649 on turnover of about HK$229.5 billion. Tencent fell 6.6% after its results and Alibaba lost 5.5% ahead of its earnings. On the mainland, the Shanghai Composite eased 0.3% to 3,577 and the Shenzhen Component 0.7% to 10,583. It is like a team losing two key players at once: the whole side's performance takes a hit.

dda.zh: 港股和科技股波动较大时,定期定额(DDA)的纪律尤其重要:固定节奏投入通常能降低单次入市时点的影响。
dda.en: When Hong Kong and tech shares swing widely, the discipline of regular (DDA) investing matters even more: a fixed rhythm generally lowers the impact of any single entry point.

prs.zh: PRS基金着眼长期,可检视其中中国与港股的比重是否符合自己的风险承受度。每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免也可一并了解。
prs.en: PRS funds are built for the long term; it may be worth checking how much China and Hong Kong exposure sits in yours against your risk tolerance, and reviewing the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 指数创新低时,单笔投资者常纠结何时入场。分批投入可分散时机风险,并留意是否过度集中在单一市场或行业,金额应配合自己的目标。
lump.en: When an index hits a fresh low, lump sum investors often struggle with timing. Phasing in may spread that risk, and it helps to check for concentration in one market or sector, sized to your own goals.

bond.zh: 港股下跌对马来西亚债券基金影响多为间接,主要通过区域风险情绪、美元与令吉走势传导。债券基金在股市波动时通常扮演稳定组合的角色。
bond.en: The Hong Kong decline reaches Malaysian bond funds mostly indirectly, through regional risk sentiment and the US dollar and ringgit. Bond funds usually play a stabilising role when equities are volatile.

title.zh: 腾讯第三季营收增8%不及预期,资本开支大增,股价创约两年半新低
title.en: Tencent's Q3 revenue grows 8% but misses estimates as capex surges; shares hit a roughly 2½-year low

analysis.zh: 据Investing.com,腾讯第三季营收按年增8%至2,073亿元人民币,低于分析师预期的2,108亿元;经调整净利润降6%至665亿元。资本开支升至814亿元(上季528亿元),游戏收入增3%,金融科技及企业服务增9%,受AI云需求带动。股价一度跌约6.1%至350港元,为2024年5月以来最低。就像一家店大举装修扩建,短期账面利润难免被压缩。
analysis.en: According to Investing.com, Tencent's third-quarter revenue rose 8% year on year to 207.3 billion yuan, below the 210.8 billion yuan analysts expected, while adjusted net profit fell 6% to 66.5 billion yuan. Capital expenditure rose to 81.4 billion yuan from 52.8 billion yuan the previous quarter; gaming revenue grew 3% and fintech and business services 9%, helped by AI cloud demand. Shares fell about 6.1% to HK$350, the lowest since May 2024. It is like a shop spending heavily on a big renovation: short-term profits are bound to look squeezed.

dda.zh: 单一公司业绩令股价大幅波动,正是分散投资的意义。信托基金通常持有众多公司,定期定额(DDA)则帮助以固定节奏参与。
dda.en: A single company's results moving its share price sharply is exactly why diversification matters. Unit trusts generally hold many companies, and regular (DDA) investing lets you take part at a steady rhythm.

prs.zh: 退休规划不必因一家公司的季度成绩而改变方向;可借机了解PRS基金的持仓分布,并记得每年最高RM3,000的税务减免。
prs.en: A retirement plan need not change direction because of one company's quarterly numbers; it may be a good moment to look at how your PRS fund's holdings are spread, and to remember the tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 个股业绩冲击提醒我们留意集中风险。单笔投资可考虑分批进场,并检查是否过度集中在少数大型科技股,金额应符合个人风险承受度。
lump.en: A shock from one company's results is a reminder of concentration risk. Lump sum investors may consider phasing in and checking for overweight positions in a few large tech names, sized to personal risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 腾讯业绩对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响有限;债券基金主要受利率、国家银行OPR、通胀与令吉影响,在股市震荡时可起到平衡作用。
bond.en: Tencent's results have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds, which mainly respond to interest rates, Bank Negara's OPR, inflation and the ringgit; they can act as a balancer when equities wobble.

title.zh: 台湾金管会拟推新卖空限制:个股单日收跌3.5%以上,翌日禁止融券卖空
title.en: Taiwan's regulator to curb short selling: a stock closing down 3.5% or more can't be shorted the next day

analysis.zh: 据The Standard转载路透社报道,台湾金融监督管理委员会表示,若个股单日收盘跌幅达3.5%或以上,翌日不得融券或借券卖空。台股加权指数当日收跌4.4%,市场对AI前景的忧虑升温;台湾已设有约150亿美元的稳定基金及先前的卖空限制。金管会称基本面仍相对稳健,上市公司营收创新高,但投资信心偏弱,会视情况调整稳定措施。就像大雨天路面湿滑,管理部门先放慢车速限制,为市场争取喘息时间。
analysis.en: According to Reuters as carried by The Standard, Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission said that if a stock closes down 3.5% or more in a day, investors may not short sell it the next trading day, via margin or borrowed securities. The benchmark closed down 4.4% as worries about AI's future grew; a US$15 billion stabilisation fund and earlier short-selling curbs are already in place. The FSC said fundamentals remain fairly solid and listed companies posted record revenue, though confidence is weak, and it will adjust stabilisation measures as needed. It is like slowing traffic on a slippery road in heavy rain: regulators slow things down to give the market room to breathe.

dda.zh: 监管措施可能缓和短期波动,但不改变市场的长期不确定性。定期定额(DDA)的价值在于不必预测底部,以固定节奏持续参与。
dda.en: Regulatory measures may soften short-term swings but do not remove longer-term uncertainty. The value of regular (DDA) investing is that you need not call the bottom; you keep participating at a steady rhythm.

prs.zh: 对长期退休储蓄而言,重点是目标与时间,而非每日新闻。可借机检视PRS基金的区域与行业分布,并留意每年最高RM3,000的税务减免。
prs.en: For long-term retirement savings, goals and time horizon matter more than daily headlines. It may be a good time to review your PRS fund's regional and sector spread, and the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 市场出现政策干预时,波动可能依然反复。单笔投资可分批进场以分散时机风险,并检查是否集中在同一主题,金额应符合自己的目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Even with policy intervention, volatility can keep swinging. Lump sum investors may phase in to spread timing risk and check for concentration in one theme, sized to their goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 台湾的卖空限制对马来西亚债券基金没有直接影响,但若区域风险情绪转差,可能间接影响外资流向与令吉。债券基金通常可作为组合的稳定器。
bond.en: Taiwan's short-selling curbs have no direct effect on Malaysian bond funds, though weaker regional risk sentiment may indirectly touch foreign flows and the ringgit. Bond funds generally act as a portfolio stabiliser.

title.zh: 金价自逾一年低位反弹至约3,743美元;CME显示12月加息25基点机率约90%
title.en: Gold rebounds to about $3,743 from a one-year-plus low; CME FedWatch shows about a 90% chance of a 25bp December hike

analysis.zh: 据CNBC,现货金价周四早段升0.6%至每盎司3,743.26美元,此前触及自2025年9月以来最低;现货白银升0.6%至45.27美元。CME FedWatch显示市场预期12月加息25个基点的机率约90%,加息50个基点约10%。美联储10月会议纪要显示官员认为可能需要加大控通胀力度,理事沃勒主张更积极回应;华侨银行称跌破3,800美元可能强化看空情绪。就像弹簧压到谷底先反弹一下,但方向仍取决于利率这只大手。
analysis.en: According to CNBC, spot gold rose 0.6% to $3,743.26 an ounce in early Thursday trade after touching its lowest since September 2025, and spot silver gained 0.6% to $45.27. CME's FedWatch tool showed about a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed hike in December and a 10% chance of 50 basis points. Minutes of the Fed's October meeting showed officials saw a growing risk they might need to intensify efforts to control inflation, with Governor Waller calling for a more aggressive response; OCBC said the break below $3,800 risks reinforcing bearish sentiment. It is like a spring bouncing once at the bottom, with the direction still set by the hand of interest rates.

dda.zh: 黄金与股市近期同样波动,说明单一资产难以预测。定期定额(DDA)配合分散的信托基金,一般有助于降低依赖单一走势的风险。
dda.en: Gold and equities have both been volatile lately, showing that no single asset is easy to predict. Regular (DDA) investing into diversified unit trusts may help reduce reliance on any single path.

prs.zh: 加息预期升温时,长期储蓄的实际回报与通胀关系更受关注。退休规划可检视PRS基金的资产分布,也别忘了每年最高RM3,000的税务减免。
prs.en: When rate-hike expectations rise, the link between long-term returns and inflation draws more attention. A retirement plan may review the asset spread in a PRS fund and the tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 金价与股市都出现回调时,单笔投资更需留意时机。分批投入可分散入市时机,并检查是否过度集中某类资产,金额应符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: With both gold and equities pulling back, timing matters more for lump sum investors. Phasing in may spread entry timing, with a check for concentration in one asset type, sized to goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 美国加息预期可能推高美债收益率与美元,令吉与外资流向也可能受影响,进而波及马来西亚政府债券(MGS)与企业债券、伊斯兰债券的价格。国家银行OPR与本地通胀仍是主要参考。
bond.en: US rate-hike expectations may lift Treasury yields and the dollar, which can affect the ringgit and foreign flows and in turn the prices of Malaysian government (MGS), corporate and sukuk holdings. Bank Negara's OPR and local inflation remain the main reference points.
